summary: @btopro I dunno, think language matters, especially to marginalized communities who have often felt the oppressive powers of language. Doesn't take much effort for me to say "blocked list" and "approved list" rather than "blacklist" and "whitelist."
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @btopro I dunno, think language matters, especially to marginalized communities who have often felt the oppressive powers of language. Doesn't take much effort for me to say "blocked list" and "approved list" rather than "blacklist" and "whitelist."
